$comment: Corpse props built by scripts/art/build-corpses.ts from each type's idle frame (pose: side = lying on its side, back = feet up, heap = collapsed bones; pool: blood, ichor or dust). 'rules' map creature spriteIds to a corpse type (first regex that matches); anything else leaves 'default'. The result lands in the manifest as props <corpseId> and corpses { spriteId: corpseId }.
